mapper.insert: INSERT INTO law_ai_search_failure_logs ( question, targets, intent_types, entity_ids, lexical_keywords, expanded_queries, failure_type, failure_stage, retryable, eval_candidate, qdrant_hit_count, vector_chunk_count, lexical_chunk_count, merged_count, ranked_count, intent_filtered_count, judge_candidate_count, judged_count, final_ground_count, result_msg, public_message, diagnostic_message ) VALUES ( #{failure.question}, #{failure.targets}, #{failure.intentTypes}, #{failure.entityIds}, #{failure.lexicalKeywords}, #{failure.expandedQueries}, #{failure.failureType}, #{failure.failureStage}, #{failure.retryable}, #{failure.evalCandidate}, #{failure.qdrantHitCount}, #{failure.vectorChunkCount}, #{failure.lexicalChunkCount}, #{failure.mergedCount}, #{failure.rankedCount}, #{failure.intentFilteredCount}, #{failure.judgeCandidateCount}, #{failure.judgedCount}, #{failure.finalGroundCount}, #{failure.resultMsg}, #{failure.publicMessage}, #{failure.diagnosticMessage} )
